const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

// the caster's glow while channelling

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// Create Phantasm: Strike — approved mockup (Party Action Animations v8).

// cfg.skin: 'mirage' (Illusionist default) | 'foxfire' (Keren). The caster's real

// token is hidden by oni.timeline for the whole run (renderable guard), so there is

// never a duplicate; her step is painted from her own texture.

if (!caster || !targets.length) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const B = await boot(); const { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E } = B;

const skinName = cfg.skin === 'foxfire' ? 'foxfire' : 'mirage';

const hue = skinName === 'foxfire' ? 330 : 275;

const dir = K.dirOf(TOK, 'c');

const tk = TG[0], TT = TOK[tk];

const cf = K.feet(tl, 'c');

const tf = K.feet(tl, tk), tmid = K.mid(tl, tk);

const skin = K.skin(tl, skinName, U);

const spot = K.summonSpot(tl, 'c');

const t = cfg.t;

// Keren: step out 40, hold, back

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back, 40);

K.circle(tl, m, U, 'c', t.cast, t.castHold, hue, { dx: dir * 40 * U });

const sx = cf.x + dir * 40 * U;

const dest = { x: tf.x - dir * 150 * U, y: tf.y };

let pos;

if (skinName === 'foxfire') {

const born = { x: sx + dir * 90 * U, y: cf.y - 10 * U };

m.clip('burst', t.appear, { x: born.x, y: born.y - 90 * U, w: 682 * 0.35 * 0.85 * U, z: 40, add: true, filter: K.tintF(330) });

pos = (e) => {

const a = t.appear;

if (e < t.dash - a) { const u = Math.min(1, e / 300); return { x: born.x, y: born.y, a: u, s: 0.2 + 0.8 * u }; }

if (e < t.slash1 - a) { const u = E.ioQ((e - (t.dash - a)) / (t.slash1 - t.dash)); return { x: born.x + (dest.x - born.x) * u, y: born.y + (dest.y - born.y) * u - Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * 40 * U, a: 1, s: 1 }; }

if (e < t.leave - a) { const k = (e - (t.slash1 - a)) % 300; const lunge = k < 140 ? E.outQ(k / 140) : 1 - E.ioQ((k - 140) / 160); return { x: dest.x + dir * 40 * U * lunge, y: dest.y, a: 1, s: 1 }; }

const u = E.ioQ(Math.min(1, (e - (t.leave - a)) / 800));

const end = (e - (t.leave - a) > 1100) ? Math.max(0, 1 - (e - (t.leave - a) - 1100) / 300) : 1;

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

// the caster's glow while channelling

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

// ── shot ──

// one on the field: a phantasm among the targets if the player picked one, else the

if (!ph) { const mine = all.filter(isMine); mine.sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.center.x - caster.center.x, a.center.y - caster.center.y) - Math.hypot(b.center.x - caster.center.x, b.center.y - caster.center.y)); ph = mine[0] || null; }

// the phantasm is drawn as 'ph', never also as a target

for (let i = targets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (isMine(targets[i])) targets.splice(i, 1);

const B = await boot(ph ? { ph: { token: ph } } : null);

const { tl, T, m, TOK, U, E } = B;

const tk = Object.keys(TOK).find((k) => /^t\d+$/.test(k) && enemies.some((x) => TOK[k].token && TOK[k].token.id === x.id));

if (!tk) { await tl.run(T, { total: 10, onStart: K.ready }); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const t = cfg.t;

const dir = K.dirOf(TOK, 'c');

const hue = cfg.dark === false ? 48 : 280;

const tf = K.feet(tl, tk), tmid = K.mid(tl, tk);

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', t.cast, t.cast, t.back, 40);

K.circle(tl, m, U, 'c', t.cast + 380, t.castHold, hue, { dx: dir * 40 * U });

const dest = { x: tf.x - dir * 60 * U, y: tf.y };

const glow = 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,65%)';

if (ph) {

const P0 = K.feet(tl, 'ph');

// selection mark: a turning dashed ring under it

K.groundRing(m, 0, t.overload, P0, 75, 75, glow, U, true);

// overload: swell + pulse, glowing in the type colour

m.hold(t.overload, t.rush, (e, S) => { const u = e / (t.rush - t.overload); const s = 1 + 0.45 * u + 0.08 * Math.sin(e / 25); const q = S.tok.ph; q.sx *= s; q.sy *= s; });

m.tint(t.overload, t.rush - t.overload, 'ph', glow, (u) => 0.25 + 0.45 * u);

// rush

m.hold(t.rush, t.boom, (e, S) => { const u = E.inQ(e / (t.boom - t.rush)); const q = S.tok.ph; q.dx += (dest.x - P0.x) * u; q.dy += (dest.y - P0.y) * u - Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * 50 * U; q.sx *= 1.45; q.sy *= 1.45; });

m.hold(t.boom, t.total, (e, S) => { S.tok.ph.hidden = true; });

} else {

const skin = K.skin(tl, cfg.skin === 'foxfire' ? 'foxfire' : 'mirage', U);

const P0 = K.summonSpot(tl, 'c');

K.phantasm(m, skin, 0, t.boom, (e) => {

if (e < t.rush) { const s = e > t.overload ? 1 + 0.45 * (e - t.overload) / (t.rush - t.overload) : 1; return { x: P0.x, y: P0.y, a: Math.min(1, e / 300), s }; }

const u = E.inQ((e - t.rush) / (t.boom - t.rush)); return { x: P0.x + (dest.x - P0.x) * u, y: P0.y + (dest.y - P0.y) * u - Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * 50 * U, a: 1, s: 1.45 };

}, true);

}

// the original explosion, under the original 0.6 dim

m.dim(t.boom, 250, 0.6); m.undim(t.boom + 1350, 250, 0.6);

m.clip('explosion', t.boom, { x: tmid.x, y: tmid.y, w: 1200 * 0.85 * 0.8 * U, z: 55, add: true });

m.shake(t.boom + 220, 520, 14 * U); m.shakeTok(t.boom + 220, tk, 400, 10 * U);

await tl.run(T, { total: t.total, sfx: cfg.sfx || [], onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

// See you later — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.party.see-you-later";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][See you later]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

}

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

}

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

// the caster's glow while channelling

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

item?.system?.props?.sourceUuid,

refs.push(...asArray(src.targetActorUUIDs));

const mpAfterOwner = Math.min(maxMp, mpBeforeOwner + recoverAmount);

"const p = ctx.params || {};",

"const nw = (v && v.videoWidth) || tex.width || 100, nh = (v && v.videoHeight) || tex.height || 100;",

"const k = (p.scale || 1) * (canvas.grid.size / (p.fileGrid || 200));",

"spr.width = nw * k; spr.height = nh * k; if (p.mirrorX) spr.scale.x *= -1; if (p.mirrorY) spr.scale.y *= -1;",

"spr.angle = -(p.rotate || 0); spr.x = p.x; spr.y = p.y; spr.alpha = p.fadeIn ? 0 : (p.opacity == null ? 1 : p.opacity);",

"spr.zIndex = p.below ? 50 : 100500; canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true; canvas.stage.addChild(spr); canvas.stage.sortChildren();",

"if (v) { try { v.loop = false; v.currentTime = 0; v.playbackRate = p.rate || 1; await v.play(); } catch (e) {} }",

"const dur = p.duration || ((v && isFinite(v.duration) ? v.duration * 1000 / (p.rate || 1) : 1000));",

"const t0 = performance.now();",

"await new Promise((res) => { const tick = () => { const e = performance.now() - t0; let a = op; if (p.fadeIn && e < p.fadeIn) a = op * e / p.fadeIn; if (p.fadeOut && e > dur - p.fadeOut) a = op * Math.max(0, (dur - e) / p.fadeOut); spr.alpha = a; if (e >= dur) { canvas.app.ticker.remove(tick); res(); } }; canvas.app.ticker.add(tick); });",

"try { spr.destroy(); } catch (e) {} try { if (v) v.pause(); } catch (e) {}",

(async () => {

async function toTokenPlaceable(ref) {

try {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

return doc.object ?? doc.token?.object ?? doc;

} catch (e) {

name: tok.name ?? tok.document?.name ?? null,

payload.sourceTokenId,

payload.casterTokenId,

globalThis._token?.document?.uuid,

globalThis.token?.document?.uuid

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

sprite.y = home.y;

sprite.height = Math.abs(baseObj.height);

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

const originalFlipX = getNativeFlipX(casterToken);

params.approachGap ??

sprite,

home,

front,

Number(params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

if (Number(params.holdMs ?? 0) > 0) {

await wait(Number(params.holdMs ?? 0));

}

await animateXY(

sprite,

front,

home,

Number(params.moveBackMs ?? params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

} finally {

if (sprite) {

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn.flipAware",

scriptSource,

targetTokenUuids: [firstTarget.document.uuid],

err("Animation crashed:", e);

try {

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn",

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id),

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id)

});

}

})();

effects.name: Grave Toll

props.description:
When a non-Villain NPC you can see that belongs to the beast, humanoid, monster, or plant Species dies, you may spend 2 Grave Points and reduce your maximum HP and MP by an amount equal to that NPC’s level. If you do, their corpse becomes a Minion who obeys your telepathic commands:

  • Its Species becomes undead and it receives all undead rules. The new Affinities to Dark, Light, and Poison damage overwrite any preexisting Affinity, but the original Species’ rules are otherwise maintained.
  • Its Rank becomes soldier; if the original creature was an elite or champion, its maximum HP is halved (Skills are maintained). (Homebrew: by the printed text the GM reduces both HP and MP.)
  • The newly created Minion is a completely new creature and has full HP, full MP, and no status effects.
  • Your Minion acts at the end of your turn: it performs a free action — one Attack or Skill of its own — chosen and driven automatically. It holds no turn of its own in the initiative order, so the GM does not count it as an additional Player Character when designing a conflict. (Homebrew: by the printed text the Minion takes its own turn and does count as an extra PC.)
  • When you rest, your Minion also gains the full benefits of resting.
  • If your Minion is reduced to 0 HP, if you are more than 1 travel day away from it, or if you die or fall unconscious, your Minion is immediately destroyed.
  • You may also destroy your Minion at any time; if you want to create a new Minion, you must first destroy the current one.
  • If your Minion is destroyed, your maximum HP and MP scores return to normal.

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

// empty: the mote then just rises and lands back on her). A violet-green mote

K.orb(m, 0, from, to, t.travel, 140, '#9dffb0', 18, U);

try {

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// Create Phantasm: Numen (Keren: Crysta) — approved mockup (v8, round 4, the

// final moon cut-in). Keren channels on a violet hexagram circle (Magic4); cut to

// night (screen space: navy radial sky + stars, 400 ms); the procedural full moon

// rises in (600 ms, Saint4); Crysta's ANIMATED battler fades in on the moon as a

// black silhouette and holds ~0.9 s; SNAP (Teleport): it squeezes into a vertical

// line (260 ms) and bursts into moonlight shards; the moon drops to black (300),

// black beat (200); back to battle (280): a moonlight streak hits the summon spot

// (Saint3) and Crysta stretches in from a vertical line (300 ms, slight

// overshoot); sparkle ring + twinkles; Keren steps back; Crysta holds 1.2 s and

// fades (the mockup's ending; BD places the real Numen token after the shot).

// The "Numen · Crysta" tag is dropped (no text in shots). No number: gate null.

if (!caster) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const B = await boot(); const { tl, T, m, TOK, U, E } = B;

const t = cfg.t;

const dir = K.dirOf(TOK, 'c');

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.settle, 46);

K.circle(tl, m, U, 'c', t.cast, t.castHold, 275, { dx: dir * 46 * U });

const V = tl.IMG.crysta || null;

if (V && typeof V.play === 'function') { try { V.muted = true; V.loop = true; const p = V.play(); if (p && p.catch) p.catch(() => {}); } catch (e) {} }

const vdim = () => ({ w: (V && (V.videoWidth || V.naturalWidth || V.width)) || 226, h: (V && (V.videoHeight || V.naturalHeight || V.height)) || 292 });

const R = tl.rng(4242);

const STARS = []; for (let i = 0; i < 220; i++) STARS.push({ x: R(), y: R(), r: R() * 1.5 + 0.3, a: 0.4 + R() * 0.6 });

const ORBS = []; for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) ORBS.push({ c: i % 3 ? '#e8eeff' : '#bcd0ff', s: 8 + R() * 10, ang: R() * 6.28, d: 120 + R() * 260, y0: R() - 0.5 });

// procedural full moon (mockup moonCanvas, R = 230 at a 788 px tall stage), seeded

let MOON = null, MOONH = 0;

const buildMoon = (Rr) => {

const k = Rr / 230, s = Math.ceil(Rr * 2 + 160 * k), c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = s; const g = c.getContext('2d'), mm = s / 2; const r = tl.rng(77);

const halo = g.createRadialGradient(mm, mm, Rr * 0.9, mm, mm, Rr + 80 * k); halo.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,248,220,.55)'); halo.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,248,220,0)');

g.fillStyle = halo; g.beginPath(); g.arc(mm, mm, Rr + 80 * k, 0, 6.3); g.fill();

const disc = g.createRadialGradient(mm - Rr * 0.25, mm - Rr * 0.25, Rr * 0.1, mm, mm, Rr); disc.addColorStop(0, '#fffdf2'); disc.addColorStop(0.75, '#efe8cf'); disc.addColorStop(1, '#d9cfae');

g.fillStyle = disc; g.beginPath(); g.arc(mm, mm, Rr, 0, 6.3); g.fill();

g.save(); g.beginPath(); g.arc(mm, mm, Rr, 0, 6.3); g.clip();

const rnd = (a, b) => a + r() * (b - a);

for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) { const x = mm + rnd(-Rr * 0.6, Rr * 0.5), y = mm + rnd(-Rr * 0.5, Rr * 0.4), rr = rnd(Rr * 0.15, Rr * 0.32);

const mg = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, rr); mg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(150,140,115,.35)'); mg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(150,140,115,0)'); g.fillStyle = mg; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, rr, 0, 6.3); g.fill(); }

for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const x = mm + rnd(-Rr, Rr), y = mm + rnd(-Rr, Rr), rr = rnd(3 * k, Rr * 0.06);

g.fillStyle = 'rgba(140,130,105,.25)'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, rr, 0, 6.3); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,245,.25)'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x - rr * 0.3, y - rr * 0.3, rr * 0.7, 0, 6.3); g.fill(); }

g.restore();

return c;

};

const clamp = (v) => (v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v);

// ── the night cut-in (screen space) ──

const cut = (g, e) => {

const W = g.W, H = g.H, sc = H / 788, MX = W / 2, MY = 300 * sc;

const cutA = e < t.cutIn + 400 ? E.sine(clamp((e - t.cutIn) / 400)) : e >= t.back ? 1 - E.sine(clamp((e - t.back) / 280)) : 1;

if (cutA <= 0) return;

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = cutA;

// sky: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%, #0d1430, #03040c 70%)

const cx = W / 2, cy = H * 0.35, rx = Math.hypot(W / 2, 0) * 1.414, ry = H * 0.65 * 1.414;

g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.scale(1, ry / rx); const sk = g.createRadialGradient(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, rx); sk.addColorStop(0, '#0d1430'); sk.addColorStop(0.7, '#03040c'); sk.addColorStop(1, '#03040c'); g.fillStyle = sk; g.fillRect(-rx - 4, -rx - 4, rx * 2 + 8, rx * 2 + 8); g.restore();

for (const s of STARS) { g.fillStyle = 'rgba(230,236,255,' + s.a.toFixed(2) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(s.x * W, s.y * H, s.r * sc, 0, 6.3); g.fill(); }

// the moon

if (e >= t.moon && e < t.black + 300) {

if (!MOON || MOONH !== H) { MOON = buildMoon(230 * sc); MOONH = H; }

const u = E.outQ(clamp((e - t.moon) / 600)); const ms = MOON.width * (0.9 + 0.1 * u);

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = cutA * u; g.drawImage(MOON, MX - ms / 2, MY - ms / 2, ms, ms); g.restore();

}

// Crysta's animated silhouette on the moon, then the SNAP

const D = vdim(); const sh = 340 * sc, sw = sh * D.w / D.h, sy0 = MY + 30 * sc;

if (V && e >= t.silIn && e < t.burst) {

const a = 0.92 * E.sine(clamp((e - t.silIn) / 400));

const u = e >= t.snap ? E.inQ(clamp((e - t.snap) / 260)) : 0;

g.save(); g.translate(MX, sy0); g.scale(1 - 0.97 * u, 1 + 0.3 * u); g.globalAlpha = cutA * a; g.filter = 'brightness(0)'; g.drawImage(V, -sw / 2, -sh / 2, sw, sh); g.restore();

}

if (e >= t.burst && e < t.burst + 180) {

const u = E.outQ((e - t.burst) / 180); const lw = 6 * sc * (1 + 3 * u), top = sy0 - sh * 0.65, lh = sh * 1.3;

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = cutA * (1 - u); g.shadowColor = '#dfe8ff'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * sc;

const lg = g.createLinearGradient(0, top, 0, top + lh); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, '#ffffff'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');

g.fillStyle = lg; g.fillRect(MX - lw / 2, top, lw, lh); g.restore();

}

if (e >= t.burst && e < t.burst + 550) {

const u = E.outQ((e - t.burst) / 550);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

for (const o of ORBS) { const x = MX + Math.cos(o.ang) * o.d * sc * u, y = sy0 + o.y0 * sh * 0.9 + Math.sin(o.ang) * o.d * 0.6 * sc * u + 40 * sc * u * u; const rr = o.s * sc / 2;

const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, rr); gr.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff'); gr.addColorStop(0.18, '#ffffff'); gr.addColorStop(0.4, o.c); gr.addColorStop(0.72, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');

g.globalAlpha = cutA * (1 - u); g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(x - rr, y - rr, rr * 2, rr * 2); }

g.restore();

}

// the moon drops to black

if (e >= t.black) { g.globalAlpha = cutA * E.inQ(clamp((e - t.black) / 300)); g.fillStyle = '#000'; g.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40); }

g.restore();

};

m.hold(t.cutIn, t.back + 281, (e0, S) => { const e = e0 + t.cutIn; S.screen.push({ draw: (g) => cut(g, e) }); });

// ── back to battle: the streak and Crysta's arrival at the summon spot ──

const P = K.summonSpot(tl, 'c');

const flipC = -dir;

m.hold(t.streak, t.settle, (e0, S) => {

const e = e0 + t.streak; const D = vdim(); const ch = D.h * 1.45 * U;

const a = e < t.stretch ? E.outQ(clamp((e - t.streak) / 120)) : 1 - E.outQ(clamp((e - t.stretch) / 300));

const sx = e < t.stretch ? 1 : 1 + 4 * E.outQ(clamp((e - t.stretch) / 300));

S.world.push({ z: 45, draw: (g) => {

const w = 8 * U * sx, top = P.y - ch * 1.6, h = ch * 1.6;

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#dfe8ff'; g.shadowBlur = 22;

const lg = g.createLinearGradient(0, top, 0, P.y); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.7, '#ffffff'); lg.addColorStop(1, '#ffffff');

g.fillStyle = lg; g.fillRect(P.x - w / 2, top, w, h); g.restore();

} });

});

if (V) m.hold(t.stretch, t.total, (e0, S) => {

const e = e0 + t.stretch; const D = vdim(); const cw = D.w * 1.45 * U, ch = D.h * 1.45 * U;

let sx = 1, sy = 1, f = 'drop-shadow(0 0 4px #dfe6ff)', a = 1;

if (e < t.settle) { const u = E.outQ(clamp((e - t.stretch) / 300)); sx = u < 0.8 ? 0.04 + 1.11 * (u / 0.8) : 1.15 - 0.15 * ((u - 0.8) / 0.2); sy = u < 0.8 ? 1.55 - 0.6 * (u / 0.8) : 0.95 + 0.05 * ((u - 0.8) / 0.2); f = 'brightness(' + (2.6 - 1.6 * u).toFixed(2) + ') drop-shadow(0 0 ' + (12 * (1 - u) + 4).toFixed(1) + 'px #dfe6ff)'; }

if (e > t.total - 400) a = clamp((t.total - e) / 400);

S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => { g.save(); g.translate(P.x, P.y); g.scale(flipC * sx, sy); g.globalAlpha = a; g.filter = f; g.drawImage(V, -cw / 2, -ch, cw, ch); g.restore(); } });

});

// sparkle ring + twinkles as she settles

m.hold(t.settle, t.settle + 450, (e, S) => {

const u = E.outQ(e / 450); const r = (30 + 110 * u) * U;

S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(220,232,255,.9)'; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.shadowColor = '#dfe8ff'; g.shadowBlur = 14; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(P.x, P.y, r, r * 0.4, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } });

});

K.twinkles(m, t.settle, { x: P.x, y: P.y - vdim().h * 1.45 * U * 0.5 }, K.tintF(220, 4, 1.3), 8, 70, U);

await tl.run(T, { total: t.total, sfx: cfg.sfx || [], onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Create Phantasm: Numen (Crysta)" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();
props.description:
You can now have up to 4 active Phantasms, but one of them must necessarily be Numen. Also, you cannot have more than one Numen Phantasm active at a time. This Phantasm cannot be used in any of the Illusionist’s Skills or Spells.

Numen is bound by the same set of special rules as any other Phantasm, with the following exceptions:

  • Numen Phantasms cost 50 MP to cast.
  • Numen’s Phantasmal Vitality equals twice your base Insight die size plus your level.
  • Once active, Numen acts at the end of your turn: it performs a free action — one Attack or Skill of its own — chosen and driven automatically. It holds no turn of its own, and does not benefit from Spells that grant additional actions.

When creating a Numen Phantasm you are prompted to choose one essence, which dictates Numen’s damage type for as long as it remains on the field:

  • Ravana — Physical
  • Asura — Light
  • Diablos — Dark

The target hit by Numen suffers 【HR + 14】 damage.

Damage dealt by Numen ignores Resistances and Immunities.

The range of the attack is determined by your current weapon.

Numen’s Phantasmal Vitality, MP and damage are all derived from you at the moment of summoning — its own sheet holds only the unscaled baseline.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 20 ― Numen’s on-hit damage increases to 18.

Skill Enhancement Lv. 40 ― Numen’s on-hit damage increases to 20.
