// Nocebo Weapon — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"totalTimeoutMs":20000,"t":{"cast":380,"castHold":700,"release":1080,"burst":1480,"total":2700},"sfx":[{"at":380,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Magic1.ogg","v":0.35},{"at":1480,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Up1.ogg","v":0.35}]};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"mc":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/Ragnarok%20Online/efst_magiccircle__mc.webm","w":112,"h":64,"dur":2417,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5},"twinkle":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/Guilty%20Gear%20Strive/webm/twinkle_anim02.webm","w":64,"h":64,"dur":250,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5,"mask":true},"powerup":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/052_powerup_2.webm","w":508,"h":630,"dur":1200,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.6508}},"images":{}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.party.keren-nocebo-weapon";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Nocebo Weapon]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

// the caster's glow while channelling

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// Nocebo Weapon — approved mockup (v8). Keren steps out on a violet (275)

// hexagram circle (Magic1) and steps back; sparks gather at the ally's weapon

// hand, then a power-up burst (MV 052_powerup_2, Up1) on the ally.

// The player's Light / Dark pick is not visible to the animation, so this uses

// ONE neutral default: white sparks and a desaturated white power-up (the

// mockup's options were gold for Light, violet for Dark). No number: gate null.

if (!caster) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const B = await boot(); const { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E } = B;

const t = cfg.t;

const dir = K.dirOf(TOK, 'c');

const tk = TG[0] || 'c';

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.release, 46);

K.circle(tl, m, U, 'c', t.cast, t.castHold, 275, { dx: dir * 46 * U });

const af = K.feet(tl, tk), adir = K.dirOf(TOK, tk);

const hand = { x: af.x + adir * 34 * U, y: af.y - TOK[tk].h * 0.45 };

K.twinkles(m, t.release, hand, 'brightness(1.3)', 7, 30, U);

m.clip('powerup', t.burst, { x: af.x, y: af.y, w: 508 * 0.85 * U, z: 50, filter: 'grayscale(1) brightness(1.3)' });

await tl.run(T, { total: t.total, sfx: cfg.sfx || [], onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Nocebo Weapon" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

};

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// Stubborn Scion (Bodyguards) — approved mockup (v8, round 3), reaction cut.

// Plays when Keren is TARGETED, before the enemy's attack animation, so the

// mockup's enemy rush / swing / run-back are left out (the real attack follows).

// Leichi and Leilan drop in from above in front of her (SE_BTL_HighJump, land

// thud SE_JUMPLANDA + dash-smoke dust + small shake), raise the jade hex barrier

// (Shield1; the mockup's hexBarrier drawn on canvas in scene space), a ripple

// runs across the hexes with the guard clang (SE_GUARDC) as if braced, a small

// shove, hold ~600 ms, the barrier fades, they hop away and vanish in smoke

// (Teleport). No "Be careful!" text, no number: gate null.

if (!caster) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const t = cfg.t;

const cf = K.feet(tl, 'c');

const imgs = [tl.IMG.leichi, tl.IMG.leilan];

const G = imgs.map((img, i) => {

const iw = (img && (img.naturalWidth || img.width)) || 150, ih = (img && (img.naturalHeight || img.height)) || 250;

return { img, w: iw * 1.15 * U, h: ih * 1.15 * U, s: spots[i], start: i * 110 };

});

// guard position + alpha at e (ms since 0)

const gpos = (gd, e) => {

const s = gd.s;

if (e < gd.start + t.fall) { const u = E.inQ(Math.max(0, (e - gd.start) / t.fall)); return { x: s.x, y: s.y - drop * (1 - u), a: 1 }; }

if (e >= t.shove && e < t.shove + 200) { const u = E.outQ((e - t.shove) / 200); return { x: s.x - dir * 14 * U * Math.sin(u * Math.PI), y: s.y, a: 1 }; }

return { x: s.x, y: s.y, a: 1 };

};

m.hold(0, t.hop + 261, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

for (const gd of G) { if (!gd.img || e < gd.start) continue; const p = gpos(gd, e); if (p.a <= 0) continue;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.scale(flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = p.a; g.filter = 'drop-shadow(0 4px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35))'; g.drawImage(gd.img, -gd.w / 2, -gd.h, gd.w, gd.h); g.restore(); }

} }));

// landing dust + thud

m.shake(t.land, 200, 5 * U);

for (const gd of G) m.clip('dashsmoke', t.land, { x: gd.s.x, y: gd.s.y - 10 * U, w: 1024 * 0.85 * 0.3 * U, z: 31, filter: 'brightness(.85)' });

// the jade hex barrier (mockup hexBarrier: 150 x 330, hex r 16, rgb 120,230,210)

const bw = 150 * U, bh = 330 * U, bc = { x: spots[0].x + dir * 85 * U, y: cf.y - 150 * U };

const rip = { x: bw / 2, y: bh / 2 - 20 * U };

const RGB = '120,230,210';

const barrier = (g, e, alpha, scx, flash) => {

g.save(); g.translate(bc.x, bc.y); g.scale(scx, 1); g.translate(-bw / 2, -bh / 2);

g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = alpha; if (flash > 0) g.filter = 'brightness(' + (1 + flash).toFixed(2) + ')';

g.save(); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(bw / 2, bh / 2, bw / 2 - 2 * U, bh / 2 - 2 * U, 0, 0, 6.3); g.clip();

const fill = g.createRadialGradient(bw / 2, bh / 2, 10 * U, bw / 2, bh / 2, bw / 2); fill.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + RGB + ',.05)'); fill.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + RGB + ',.35)'); g.fillStyle = fill; g.fillRect(0, 0, bw, bh);

const r = 16 * U, hx = r * 1.732, hy = r * 1.5; const k = (e - t.hit) / 500;

g.lineWidth = 1.6 * U;

for (let y = -r, row = 0; y < bh + r; y += hy, row++) for (let x = (row % 2) * hx / 2 - hx; x < bw + hx; x += hx) {

let a = 0.25 + 0.15 * Math.sin(e / 300 + x / U * 0.05 + y / U * 0.04);

if (k >= 0) { const d = Math.hypot(x - rip.x, y - rip.y); a += Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(d - k * bw) / (30 * U)) * (1 - Math.min(1, k)) * 1.2; }

g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + RGB + ',' + Math.min(1, a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.beginPath();

for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const an = Math.PI / 3 * i + Math.PI / 6; const px = x + r * Math.cos(an), py = y + r * Math.sin(an); if (i) g.lineTo(px, py); else g.moveTo(px, py); }

g.closePath(); g.stroke();

}

g.restore();

g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + RGB + ',.9)'; g.lineWidth = 3 * U; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(bw / 2, bh / 2, bw / 2 - 3 * U, bh / 2 - 3 * U, 0, 0, 6.3); g.stroke();

g.restore();

};

m.hold(t.land, t.fade + 300, (e0, S) => {

const e = e0 + t.land;

const up = E.outQ(Math.min(1, e0 / 300));

const alpha = e < t.fade ? up : Math.max(0, 1 - (e - t.fade) / 300);

const scx = 0.3 + 0.7 * up;

const flash = (e >= t.hit && e < t.hit + 220) ? 1 - E.outQ((e - t.hit) / 220) : 0;

S.world.push({ z: 35, draw: (g) => barrier(g, e, alpha, scx, flash) });

});

// the braced hit: sparks at the impact point on the barrier

K.twinkles(m, t.hit, { x: bc.x - bw / 2 + rip.x, y: bc.y - bh / 2 + rip.y }, K.tintF(165, 4, 1.3), 4, 25, U);

// they vanish in smoke

for (const gd of G) m.clip('smoke11', t.hop, { x: gd.s.x, y: gd.s.y - gd.h * 0.5, w: 170 * 0.85 * 2.2 * U, z: 36, hold: t.total - t.hop, filter: 'brightness(.85)', alpha: (u) => 1 - Math.max(0, (u - 0.6) / 0.4) });

await tl.run(T, { total: t.total, sfx: cfg.sfx || [], onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();
props.description:
You hail from the wealthiest, most influential family in this region. On what do they

base their fortune and reputation? Are you the only heir? What is it about your family

you really can’t stand, and why did it lead you to join the other characters?

If you choose this Quirk during character creation, increase your initial savings (see

Core Rulebook, page 165) by 1000 zenit.

Additionally, you are accompanied by two fiercely loyal bodyguards: give them a name

and describe their appearance. They do not have an NPC profile and never take part in

Checks or conflicts, but you are inseparable and they somehow appear whenever you

need their help. They offer the following benefits:

  • Be careful! When you suffer damage, you may halve it.

  • Here is the information you previously requested. During a Rest, you may ask the

Game Master one question; they will answer truthfully.

  • Stay down, I'll take care of this! When you create an elemental shard, you may have

it deal extra damage equal to 【5 + half your level】.

Whenever you make use of one of these benefits, your bodyguards suffer 1d6 Fatigue

Points; as long as they have 10 or more Fatigue Points, you cannot rely on them.

Fatigue is shared between bodyguards; it is not tracked individually.

At the end of each session (approximately four hours of play), your bodyguards recover

from 1d6 Fatigue Points (to a minimum of zero).

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

// the caster's glow while channelling

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

} }));

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

// ── Zero Power kit (prepended after the party _kit by zp-signatures.js) ──────

// Shared pieces of the four party Zero Powers (2026-11-06 overhaul, mockup v17):

// the shipped full-body cut-in, hit cues, the cast focus fade, the game's flinch

// for painted copies, screen anchors for numbers, and small particle helpers.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const ZP = {};

// Fire something ONCE when the timeline reaches 'at' (tracks run per frame while

// t0 <= t < t1, so a 1 ms window can be skipped; this one stays open).

ZP.once = (m, at, fn) => { let done = false; m.hold(at, 1e9, () => { if (done) return; done = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ZP] once threw', e); } }); };

// A Chain tick: reveals the next strike (number, HP bar, counter) on the acting GM.

// info: { numbersOnly, screenAt: { [tokenUuid]: { fx, fy } } } or a function returning it.

// paced: every Zero Power cues each strike itself, so the presenter never fills a gap with its own beat.

ZP.hit = (m, at, info) => ZP.once(m, at, () => oni.hit(Object.assign({ paced: true }, typeof info === 'function' ? info() : (info || {}))));

// The shipped Zero Power cut-in (createCutinDOM/runCutinDOM): a full-body image

// 92% of the view tall on the bottom edge; left -120% -> 0 (CSS ease-out, 650 ms),

// hold 850 ms, -> 120% (CSS ease-in, 650 ms). Drawn in screen space above the board.

// Needs A.images[key]; Overdrive is a cfg sfx cue at the same time.

ZP.cssOut = (t) => ZP.bez(0, 0, 0.58, 1, t);

ZP.cssIn = (t) => ZP.bez(0.42, 0, 1, 1, t);

ZP.bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x) => { let t = x; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx; const fx = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; const d = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break; t -= fx / d; } const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by; return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t; };

ZP.cutin = (tl, m, at, key, o) => {

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => { const img = tl.IMG[key]; if (!img) return; (o.over ? S.over : S.screen).push({ draw: (g) => {

const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = g.H * 0.92, w = h * iw / ih;

const x = e < inMs ? -1.2 * g.W * (1 - ZP.cssOut(e / inMs)) : e < inMs + hold ? 0 : 1.2 * g.W * ZP.cssIn((e - inMs - hold) / outMs);

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

return at + end;

};

// Everyone on the board who is not the caster or a target, as extra timeline tokens

// ('b0', 'b1', ...), so the cast focus can fade them. Summon tokens already on the

// field are bystanders too (the user's dedupe rule: the parade never shows a real

// Crysta next to the drawn one). keep: extra tokens to leave alone.

ZP.bystanders = (keep) => {

const out = {}; const skip = new Set(); if (caster) skip.add(caster.id); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); for (const t of (keep || [])) if (t) skip.add(t.id);

let n = 0; for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; out['b' + (n++)] = { token: t }; }

return out;

};

// Fade the bystanders out from 'at' over ms, keep them out until 'back', fade back over backMs.

ZP.focus = (m, TOK, at, ms, back, backMs) => {

const keys = Object.keys(TOK).filter((k) => k.charAt(0) === 'b' && /^b[0-9]+$/.test(k));

for (const k of keys) m.hold(at, back + backMs, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const t = e + at; let a; if (t < at + ms) a = 1 - (t - at) / ms; else if (t < back) a = 0; else a = Math.min(1, (t - back) / backMs); if (a < 1) { if (a <= 0.001) q.hidden = true; else q.alpha *= a; } });

};

// The game's FULL_FLINCH (battler-pose.js): [time, scaleX, scaleY, shiftX px] and brightness.

ZP.FLINCH = {

normal: { ms: 300, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.12, 1.12, 0.88, 0], [0.30, 0.97, 1.03, -7], [0.50, 1, 1, 6], [0.70, 1, 1, -4], [0.85, 1, 1, 3], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 3.6], [0.35, 1], [1, 1]] },

strong: { ms: 480, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.10, 1.22, 0.80, 0], [0.26, 0.90, 1.10, -13], [0.44, 1, 1, 11], [0.62, 1, 1, -7], [0.80, 1, 1, 5], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 4], [0.20, 1], [0.40, 3.2], [0.60, 1], [1, 1]] },

};

// Flinch sample at ms since the hit: { sx, sy, dx, b (brightness) } or null when over.

// The hurt reaction on a PAINTED timeline token k at 'at': its hurt art (sprite_hurt,

// the engine's hurt loop) for hurtMs with the flinch on top, else the flinch alone.

// Use with oni.hit({ numbersOnly: true }) so the game's own DOM flinch stays off.

ZP.flinchTok = (m, at, k, tier, hurtMs) => {

// Splitting for a drawn pseudo multi-hit preview (bench only; in battle the numbers come from BD).

// A soft additive glow (canvas 2D).

// drawn by draw(g, p, e). Lets a whole ember/dust swarm live in one track (no per-frame spawns).

// Tip and joint of a Disgaea weapon part, read from its alpha (top-most / bottom-most opaque rows).

ZP._li = new Map();

ZP.limbInfo = (img) => { if (ZP._li.has(img)) return ZP._li.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); let d; try { d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data; } catch (e) { const r0 = { tip: { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r0); return r0; }

const propsOf = (t) => (t && t.document && t.document.actor && t.document.actor.system && t.document.actor.system.props) || {};

for (let i = targets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (isMine(targets[i])) targets.splice(i, 1);

// ── the parade, in the KEYWORDS order (skill-formulas OWN_PHANTASM/MINION/NUMEN_COUNT, ON_FIELD) ──

const phantasms = allTok.filter((t) => isMine(t) && flagsOf(t).isPhantasm);

const numens = allTok.filter((t) => isMine(t) && (flagsOf(t).isNumen || propsOf(t).isNumen));

const minions = allTok.filter((t) => isMine(t) && flagsOf(t).cloneActorUuid && !flagsOf(t).isPhantasm);

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

async function boot(extra) {

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// Brainwave Discharge — approved mockup (v8, round 3, purple psychic theme).

// Violet dim (#160626 at 0.5, under the tokens like the mockup's dim layer),

// Keren steps out 30 and trembles with violet sparks at her head, the RO

// howlingoflion cast swirl gathers under her (Magic4), then the RO howlingoflion

// burst detonates on each enemy 120 ms apart (Darkness4 each); damage on each

// burst's impact (350 ms). Gate = the first enemy's impact.

if (!caster) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const B = await boot(); const { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E } = B;

if (!TG.length) { await tl.run(T, { total: 10, onStart: K.ready }); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const t = cfg.t;

const dir = K.dirOf(TOK, 'c');

const cf = K.feet(tl, 'c');

const SC = tl.SCENE;

const rel = t.burst + (TG.length - 1) * 120 + 833; // all bursts done: step back + undim

// violet dim: in 500 (sine) from 0, out 500 once every burst is done

m.hold(0, rel + 520, (e, S) => {

const a = e < 500 ? 0.5 * E.sine(e / 500) : e < rel ? 0.5 : 0.5 * (1 - E.sine(Math.min(1, (e - rel) / 500)));

if (a <= 0) return;

S.world.push({ z: 0, draw: (g) => { g.save(); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(22,6,38,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'; g.fillRect(SC.x - SC.w, SC.y - SC.h, SC.w * 3, SC.h * 3); g.restore(); } });

});

// step out 30, tremble 600 ms with violet sparks around her head

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, rel, 30);

const hd = K.head(tl, 'c');

K.twinkles(m, t.tremble, { x: hd.x + dir * 30 * U, y: hd.y }, K.tintF(280, 4, 1.3), 6, 30, U);

m.hold(t.tremble, t.tremble + 600, (e, S) => { S.tok.c.dx += Math.sin((e / 600) * 60) * 3 * U; });

// the swirl gathers under her

m.clip('howlCast', t.swirl, { x: cf.x + dir * 30 * U, y: cf.y, w: 162 * 0.85 * 1.9 * 1.3 * U, z: 2, add: true });

// a burst on each enemy, 120 ms apart

const sfx = (cfg.sfx || []).slice();

TG.forEach((tk, i) => {

const at = t.burst + i * 120, tf = K.feet(tl, tk);

m.clip('howl', at, { x: tf.x, y: tf.y, w: 862 * 0.85 * 1.9 * 0.6 * U, z: 50, add: true });

m.shakeTok(at + t.impact, tk, 300, 9 * U);

m.tint(at + t.impact, 220, tk, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.6 * (1 - u));

if (cfg.burstSfx) sfx.push({ at, url: cfg.burstSfx.url, v: cfg.burstSfx.v });

});

await tl.run(T, { total: rel + 520, sfx, onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Brainwave Discharge" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

While your Brainwave Clock is full, you may use an action to erase all of its sections. If you do, choose one option:

  • You deal 20 Physical damage to every enemy that is present on the scene
  • You deal 30 Physical damage to a single enemy you can see

Skill Enhancement Lv. 20 ― The damage increases to 30 (all enemies) or 40 (single enemy).

Skill Enhancement Lv. 40 ― The damage increases to 40 (all enemies) or 50 (single enemy).
